lines.en: label dormwar5:
scene friendzonefight1
I make my way into the cafe to find Ami and Maya and quickly approach-
lines.zh: 我走进咖啡店想找 Ami 和 Maya，快步上前——

lines.en: scene friendzonefight2
I make my way into the cafe and decide to talk to Haruka first since this is her business and I just walked in with over ten [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: 我走进咖啡店，决定先跟 Haruka 打个招呼，毕竟这是她的店，而我刚带着十几个[teenage]女孩闯了进来。

lines.en: : Well I guess this kind of explains why both Rin and Molly told me they needed off today.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这大概就解释了为什么 Rin 和 Molly 都跟我说今天要请假。

lines.en: : The girls are having a battle to see who gets to sleep with me during the next beach trip.
lines.zh: : 女孩们在比赛，看谁能在下次海边旅行时和我一起睡。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : You heard me, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 你听到了，Haruka。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight3
: They’re going to at least buy stuff, though...right? Because if one or two girls want to just hang out here, it’s totally fine...but you guys are about to take up like half of the store.
lines.zh: : 不过她们至少会买点东西……对吧？要是一两个女生想在这儿坐坐完全没问题……可你们这么多人马上要占掉半个店了。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Probably?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概会吧？

lines.en: : Two of them are loaded, so they’ll probably wind up buying stuff.
lines.zh: : 其中两个很有钱，所以她们大概会买点东西。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight4
: Cool. Well, as long as you don’t just sit around and make a mess of the place, that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 行吧。只要你们别光坐着把店里搞得一团糟，就没问题。

lines.en: : Not gonna say no to a bunch of cute girls showing up and-
lines.zh: : 一堆可爱女生上门，我总不能说不——

lines.en: scene friendzonefight5
: Hey, wait. Why is your entire class absolutely adorable? How’d you luck out like that?
lines.zh: : 等等。你们班怎么一个个都这么可爱？你哪来这么好的运气？

lines.en: : Everyone I know is adorable, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我认识的人都很可爱，Haruka。

lines.en: I wink at Haruka.
lines.zh: 我朝 Haruka 使了个眼色。

lines.en: : No, like really though.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说真的。

lines.en: The wink doesn’t do much, apparently.
lines.zh: 看来这个眼色没什么效果。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight6
: Morning, Haruka! You sure look adorable today.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Haruka！你今天看起来真可爱。

lines.en: : I don’t think she’s in the mood for compliments. I just tried saying the same thing and she didn’t even have a response.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她现在没心情听人夸。我刚刚试着说了同样的话，她一点反应都没有。

lines.en: : Bold move to request off and then show up to work, Rin.
lines.zh: : Rin，请了假又跑来上班，胆子不小啊。

lines.en: : I’m a bold girl.
lines.zh: : 我本来就是个大胆的女孩。

lines.en: : Besides, Otoha and me have to friend zone our teacher so that one of us can sleep with him over the summer.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我和 Otoha 得把我们的老师打进朋友区，这样其中一个就能在夏天跟他一起睡。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight7
: Wait...what? You have to friend zone him {i}so{/i} you can sleep with him?
lines.zh: : 等等……什么？你们得把他打进朋友区{i}才能{/i}跟他睡？

lines.en: : Girls have really changed since I was in [high_school].
lines.zh: : 现在的女孩跟我当年在[high_school]时真是大不一样了。

lines.en: : She means sleep in the same room.
lines.zh: : 她的意思是睡在同一个房间。

lines.en: : Whichever one of us holds off Sensei the longest gains a point for our team.
lines.zh: : 我们谁撑得最久不被 Sensei 拿下，谁就为我们队拿一分。

lines.en: : And whichever team has the most points by tomorrow night gets to tie him up and keep him in our room for the beach.
lines.zh: : 到明天晚上得分最多的那一队，就可以把他绑起来，在海边旅行时关在我们房间里。

lines.en: : Wait, I'm getting tied up?
lines.zh: : 等等，我要被绑起来？

lines.en: : And what does the losing team get?
lines.zh: : 那输掉的那队能得到什么？

lines.en: : Nadda.
lines.zh: : 啥也没有。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight8
: Well then I suppose I’ll just have to keep my schedule open so the losing team doesn’t have to go empty handed.
lines.zh: : 那我看我得把日程空出来，免得输的那队两手空空。

lines.en: : Smooth.
lines.zh: : 说得真溜。

lines.en: : I’m doing this for today’s youth, not myself.
lines.zh: : 我这可都是为了当代的年轻人，不是为了我自己。

lines.en: : So, do you know how this is gonna work, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei，你知道这场是怎么比的吗？

lines.en: : Apparently, the two of you are going to try to not fall in love with me or something.
lines.zh: : 据说，你们俩要努力不爱上我之类的。

lines.en: : Basically.
lines.zh: : 差不多。

lines.en: : You’re going to take turns spending time with both Otoha and me. And if you can manage to get one of us to flirt with you, that person loses.
lines.zh: : 你要轮流陪我和 Otoha。要是你能让我俩其中一个跟你调情，那个人就输。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight9
: Technically, one of us can still lose even if we don’t flirt. But that will have to be decided by our totally unbiased roommates.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，就算没调情，我们其中一个也可能输。不过那得由我们绝对公正的室友来判定。

lines.en: : And...how does that work, exactly? What do Futaba and Nodoka have to do with this?
lines.zh: : 那……具体怎么操作？Futaba 和 Nodoka 跟这有什么关系？

lines.en: : Those two know us really well, so they’ll be able to tell when and if we start feelin’ something.
lines.zh: : 她们俩太了解我们了，所以能看出我们是不是、以及什么时候开始有感觉。

lines.en: : It’s doubtful that either one of them will sell us out, so they’re kinda just there to make sure no one’s cheating or whatever.
lines.zh: : 她们应该不会出卖我们，所以基本就是在那儿确保没人作弊什么的。

lines.en: : Really, why are you so lucky?
lines.zh: : 说真的，你怎么运气这么好？

lines.en: : No one has ever had a contest over me before. Let alone one important enough to ditch work for.
lines.zh: : 从来没有人为了我办过什么比赛。更别说是重要到能让人翘班的比赛了。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure if taking turns being rejected constitutes {i}lucky{/i}, but it’s not like every contest so far has been as anti-Sensei as this one.
lines.zh: : 我不确定轮流被拒绝算不算{i}运气好{/i}，不过目前为止也不是每场比赛都像这场一样针对 Sensei 本人。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
: Hey, I’m not anti-Sensei at all! If anything, I’m pro-Sensei! That dude’s the best.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我才不反 Sensei 呢！要说的话，我是挺 Sensei 派！那家伙最棒了。

lines.en: else:
: Yeah. Crazy how there are some girls out there who might be interested in {i}other{/i} people and are actually able to prevent mindlessly throwing themselves at you.
lines.zh: : 是啊。真离谱，居然有些女生会对{i}别人{/i}感兴趣，而且还能忍住不无脑往你身上扑。

lines.en: : Yeah...crazy.
lines.zh: : 是啊……离谱。

lines.en: : Either way, I guess we can get started whenever-
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我想我们随时都可以开始——

lines.en: : Sensei! You haven’t congratulated me on my victory yet! Get over here, ya big doofus!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你还没祝贺我获胜呢！过来，你这个大笨蛋！

lines.en: : That girl with the giant jacket just called you a doofus.
lines.zh: : 那个穿着超大外套的女生刚刚叫你大笨蛋。

lines.en: : Are you just going to let her talk to you like that?
lines.zh: : 你就这么由着她这么跟你说话？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. I will put an end to this right now.
lines.zh: : 当然不行。我这就去终结这一切。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight10
: Who are you calling a-
lines.zh: : 你敢叫谁——

lines.en: : Oh. Maki is here too.
lines.zh: : 哦。Maki 也在啊。

lines.en: : I’m Maki.
lines.zh: : 我是 Maki。

lines.en: : Is what my second daughter says true?
lines.zh: : 我二女儿说的是真的吗？

lines.en: : Second daughter?
lines.zh: : 二女儿？

lines.en: : She’s obviously talkin’ about me. Go on and tell Maki about how I whooped Kirin’s butt so bad that she didn’t even come with us to the cafe.
lines.zh: : 她说的明显是我。快跟 Maki 讲讲我是怎么把 Kirin 打得落花流水，连咖啡店都没跟着我们来。

lines.en: : She didn’t?
lines.zh: : 她没来？

lines.en: : Nah. Said she had some stuff to do.
lines.zh: : 没来。说她有点事要办。

lines.en: : Now, tell her the story.
lines.zh: : 现在，快把故事讲给她听。

lines.en: : Or don’t tell her the story because it would be rude for us to brag about a victory so early on in the competition.
lines.zh: : 或者别讲，因为比赛才刚开始就吹嘘胜利，太失礼了。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight11
: Or {i}do{/i} tell the story because I want to hear about Miku’s glorious victory.
lines.zh: : 或者{i}还是{/i}讲吧，因为我想听听 Miku 的光辉胜利。

lines.en: : See! Tell her I won and stuff!
lines.zh: : 看吧！跟她说我赢了什么的！

lines.en: : Miku won and stuff.
lines.zh: : Miku 赢了什么的。

lines.en: : But it wasn’t entirely one sided. The other girl put up a fight.
lines.zh: : 不过也不算完全一边倒。另一个女生也挺拼的。

lines.en: : Whaaaaat? Miku absolutely destroyed the other girl and it wasn’t even close to a contest? That’s crazy.
lines.zh: : 什——么？Miku 把另一个女生彻底打爆，根本算不上一场比赛？太夸张了。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight12
: Great job, second daughter.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，二女儿。

lines.en: : Thanks, Maki! Couldn’t have done it without your support!
lines.zh: : 谢谢 Maki！没有你的支持我做不到！

lines.en: : Those two aren’t always like this, are they?
lines.zh: : 她们俩不是一直都这样吧？

lines.en: : They are, more or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多一直都这样。

lines.en: : Miku and I have known each other for a long time, so naturally she’s already...acquainted with my mother.
lines.zh: : Miku 和我认识很久了，所以她自然早就……认识我母亲了。

lines.en: : Why are you still over here, though? It looks like Rin and Otoha have already set up and are patiently awaiting you.
lines.zh: : 不过你怎么还在这儿？看样子 Rin 和 Otoha 已经摆好阵势，正耐心等着你呢。

lines.en: I turn around to find the two of them at different tables across from one another, accompanied by none other than their respective roommates.
lines.zh: 我转过身，发现她俩坐在相对的两张桌子旁，陪着她们的正是各自的室友。

lines.en: The thing is, I still don’t really know what I’m supposed to do.
lines.zh: 问题是，我还是不太清楚自己该做什么。

lines.en: : So...do I just like-
lines.zh: : 那么……我只要——

lines.en: : Just be yourself. You’re an incorrigible lust demon, so whatever you do is bound to be within the confines of what they expect from you.
lines.zh: : 做你自己就好。你是个无可救药的色欲恶魔，所以不管你做什么，肯定都在她们对你的预期范围内。

lines.en: : I am {i}not{/i} an incorrigible lust demon.
lines.zh: : 我才{i}不是{/i}什么无可救药的色欲恶魔。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight13
: Hey! Are you trying to say you have something against incorrigible lust demons?
lines.zh: : 嘿！你是在说你对无可救药的色欲恶魔有意见吗？

lines.en: : Nope. You’re great, Maki. Keep...being you.
lines.zh: : 没有。你很棒，Maki。继续……做你自己。

lines.en: : I will!
lines.zh: : 我会的！

lines.en: : Now go over there and show those girls that they are too [young]for you! And that you would be much better off with a brand new fleshlight from my store!
lines.zh: : 现在就去那边，让那些女孩知道她们对你来说太[young]了！还有，你还不如来我店里买个全新的飞机杯呢！

lines.en: : What's a fleshlight?
lines.zh: : 什么是飞机杯？

lines.en: : Yup. See ya.
lines.zh: : 好嘞。回头见。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way through the store and over to Rin, who’s seated next to Futaba in the back of the cafe.
lines.zh: 我穿过店里，走向坐在咖啡店后排的 Rin，Futaba 就坐在她旁边。

lines.en: I figure that it will be easier getting her to cave since I’ve known her for much longer.
lines.zh: 我想，让她先崩溃应该更容易些，毕竟我认识她的时间长得多。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
Granted, I’ve also absolutely shat all over her trust before.
lines.zh: 话说回来，我以前也确确实实把她的信任踩得稀碎。

lines.en: But even with that, I still feel closer to her than I do with Otoha.
lines.zh: 但即便如此，我仍觉得自己和她比和 Otoha 更亲近。

lines.en: Either way, I guess there’s no way to tell unless I try so...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，不试试看是不知道的，所以……

lines.en: Here goes nothing.
lines.zh: 管他呢，上吧。

lines.en: else:
That being said, there’s a much higher chance of me winning her over rather than Otoha.
lines.zh: 话说回来，我拿下她的概率要比拿下 Otoha 高得多。

lines.en: Or...at least I think there is.
lines.zh: 或者……至少我是这么想的。

lines.en: I guess there’s no way to tell unless I try, so...
lines.zh: 不试试看是不知道的，所以……

lines.en: Here goes nothing.
lines.zh: 管他呢，上吧。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight14
: Yo.
: Sorry, but I don’t want any.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我什么都不要。

lines.en: : ...Don’t want any what?
lines.zh: : ……不要什么？

lines.en: : Any of {i}that ass{/i}. Now get out of here.
lines.zh: : 不要你{i}那套{/i}。赶紧走吧。

lines.en: : I...am so sorry...
lines.zh: : 我……非常抱歉……

lines.en: scene black
I don’t want to deal with Rin right now, so I go talk to Otoha instead.
lines.zh: 我现在不想应付 Rin，于是改去找 Otoha 说话。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight15
: Jesus, did you really strike out with Rin already? Or are you here to tell me I won?
lines.zh: : 天啊，你真的这么快就在 Rin 那儿碰壁了？还是说你是来宣布我赢了的？

lines.en: : I gave up on Rin for the time being. I’ll be back over there in a few minutes as long as you’re able to resist my overwhelming masculinity and mysterious aura.
lines.zh: : 我暂时先放弃 Rin 了。只要你能抵挡住我压倒性的男人味和神秘气质，我过几分钟就回去。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight16
: God damnit.
lines.zh: : 妈的。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene friendzonefight17
: Come on! All you have to do is...well, literally anything.
lines.zh: : 拜托！你只要做……呃，任何事就行。

lines.en: : Just one time and I won’t bother you again for the rest of the tournament.
lines.zh: : 就这一次，之后整场比赛我都不会再烦你了。

lines.en: : Don’t you want Sensei in our room for the beach thingie?
lines.zh: : 你难道不想在海边那档子事的时候让 Sensei 住进我们房间吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even know what “the beach thingie” is, but it very much sounds like a thing I don’t want to go to.
lines.zh: : 我连“海边那档子事”是什么都不知道，不过听起来很像我完全不想去的东西。

lines.en: : Io! You can’t just keep avoiding everything ever.
lines.zh: : Io！你不能永远躲开所有事情啊。

lines.en: : There are plenty of nice girls in the class who are more than willing to deal with...you.
lines.zh: : 班上有不少好女生，都很乐意应付……你。

lines.en: : That’s great news. Then they won’t mind me wanting literally nothing to do with any of them.
lines.zh: : 那可真是好消息。那她们也不会介意我跟她们当中任何一个都毫无瓜葛了。

lines.en: : I’m glad to have such an understanding group of girls in our class.
lines.zh: : 我们班能有这么一群通情达理的女生，我真高兴。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight18
: Can you at least fake it or something?
lines.zh: : 你至少能装装样子什么的吧？

lines.en: : Ew, fake it even more than I am by showing up?
lines.zh: : 恶心，我都已经靠露面在装了，还要再装？

lines.en: : You do realize this {i}is{/i} me faking it, right? I’d much rather be in bed right now.
lines.zh: : 你知道我现在就{i}是{/i}在装吧？我宁可现在躺在床上。

lines.en: : Io! I really wanna win this...
lines.zh: : Io！我真的很想赢这场……

lines.en: scene friendzonefight19
: Well, good news! If you really want to sleep with Sensei, there are much easier ways of doing it!
lines.zh: : 好吧，好消息！如果你真想和 Sensei 睡，有的是更简单的办法！

lines.en: : Ways that don’t involve you trying to make me do things you know I don’t want to do!
lines.zh: : 用不着你逼我去做你知道我不愿意做的事！

lines.en: : That’s not why I want to win...
lines.zh: : 我想赢不是为了那个……

lines.en: : Oooooh, okay okay. You just want everyone to like you. Got it.
lines.zh: : 哦——好好好。你只是想让所有人都喜欢你。明白了。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight20
: Tch...whatever. I hate dealing with you when you’re like this.
lines.zh: : 啧……随便吧。你这样的时候我最不想应付了。

lines.en: : Hahahahah come on! I’m only like, half-kidding.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈拜托！我只是，一半在开玩笑啦。

lines.en: : But yeah, don't count on me cooperating in any way.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，别指望我会以任何方式配合。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight21
: Hey, welcome back to the cool kids table. Does Otoha want your penis yet?
lines.zh: : 嘿，欢迎回到酷小孩桌。Otoha 想要你的鸡巴了吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我觉得还没有。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Wow. She already lasted longer than Chika did then. Good for her.
lines.zh: : 哇。那她已经比 Chika 撑得还久了。真有她的。

lines.en: : I am...{i}really{/i} sorry...
lines.zh: : 我……{i}真的{/i}很抱歉……

lines.en: else:
: Damn it.
lines.zh: : 该死。

lines.en: : Oh well. Just keep trying then, I guess.
lines.zh: : 算了。那你就继续加油吧，我想。

lines.en: : You know, I never realized how hard it is to flirt with someone when I am literally being forced to.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我以前从没意识到，被人逼着去跟谁调情会有多难。

lines.en: : That’s probs just cause you see me as a friend.
lines.zh: : 那大概是因为你把我当朋友看。

lines.en: : You can’t flirt with me because you don’t want to break our sweet bromance.
lines.zh: : 你没法跟我调情，是因为你不想破坏我们这段甜甜的兄弟情。

lines.en: : A bromance implies that you’re a male.
lines.zh: : 兄弟情的前提是你得是个男的。

lines.en: : Homance, then. Homie romance.
lines.zh: : 那就叫“铁子情”吧。老铁浪漫。

lines.en: : Homance makes it sound like you’re a slut.
lines.zh: : Homance 听起来像是在说你是个荡妇。

lines.en: : The hell do you want from me, man? Not my fault you’re not attracted to me.
lines.zh: : 你到底想怎样啊老兄？你喜欢不上我又不是我的错。

lines.en: : I am very much attracted to you, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我可非常喜欢你啊，Rin。

lines.en: : Also, sorry if that made this conversation weird, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 还有，Futaba，如果这让对话变奇怪了，抱歉。

lines.en: : It was...already weird, so...
lines.zh: : 本来……就已经很奇怪了，所以……

lines.en: : If you’re so attracted to me, how come you’ve never asked for my number?
lines.zh: : 如果你真那么喜欢我，怎么从来没问过我要电话号码？

lines.en: : That’s like step one of picking people up- something I am obviously very experienced with.
lines.zh: : 那可是搭讪的第一步——这方面我经验可丰富了。

lines.en: : Oh. Because I already have it.
lines.zh: : 哦。因为我已经有了。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight22
: Did you give Sensei my number?
lines.zh: : 你把我的号码给 Sensei 了？

lines.en: : Not...that I’m aware of.
lines.zh: : 我记得……没有。

lines.en: : I got it from someone else.
lines.zh: : 我是从别人那儿拿到的。

lines.en: Thanks, Haruka.
lines.zh: 谢了，Haruka。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight23
: That’s so weird!
lines.zh: : 太奇怪了吧！

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like I went out of my way to get it or anything.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我又没有特地去弄到它什么的。

lines.en: : No! It’s weird that you’ve never even sent me a “hey” or anything!
lines.zh: : 不是！奇怪的是你连一句“嘿”都没给我发过！

lines.en: : I was just joking at first, but I guess you really {i}aren’t{/i} attracted to me at all!
lines.zh: : 我一开始只是开玩笑，不过看来你是真的一点都{i}不{/i}喜欢我！

lines.en: : Well, are you attracted to me?
lines.zh: : 那，你喜欢我吗？

lines.en: : I can’t answer that question or I’ll probably lose!
lines.zh: : 我不能回答这个问题，不然我大概就输了！

lines.en: : I feel like even saying that should kind of count as a loss.
lines.zh: : 我觉得光是说出这句话，就该算输了。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight24
: As Rin’s lawyer, I’d like to ask you to please give us a moment to discuss...strategy with one another.
lines.zh: : 作为 Rin 的律师，我想请你给我们一点时间，让我们……商量一下策略。

lines.en: : It seems unfair that most of your time has been spent at this table so far.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止你的时间基本都花在这张桌子上了，这似乎不太公平。

lines.en: : Fine. But only because I don’t want to get yelled at anymore.
lines.zh: : 行。不过只是因为我不想再被吼了。

lines.en: : If this is because I wear basketball shorts to bed, I just want you to know they’re very comfortable and-
lines.zh: : 如果是因为我穿篮球短裤睡觉，我只想让你知道那真的很舒服，而且——

lines.en: : Rin...a moment, please.
lines.zh: : Rin……拜托，安静一会儿。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene friendzonefight25
: You doing okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: This is probably kind of hard for you to watch, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 看着这些，你大概挺难受的吧？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Hey, want to go outside and talk for a little while?
lines.zh: : 嘿，要不要出去聊一会儿？

lines.en: : Doesn't have to be about them or the contest or anything.
lines.zh: : 不一定要聊她们或比赛什么的。

lines.en: : Just...might be good to take your mind off of things.
lines.zh: : 只是……也许能让你散散心。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight26
: Yeah...
lines.zh: : 好啊……

lines.en: scene black
scene friendzonefight27
: So, Touka, how are you adjusting to life outside of your...{i}bubble?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那么，Touka，你适应……{i}泡泡{/i}之外的生活了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我没听懂。

lines.en: : Is that some sort of joke that commoners tell each other?
lines.zh: : 那是平民之间互相讲的某种笑话吗？

lines.en: scene friendzonefight28
: Well...no. I meant like...cause our families both make bubble wrap.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是。我的意思是……因为我们两家都是做泡泡纸的。

lines.en: : And being in a bubble is another word for being sheltered and...
lines.zh: : 而“待在泡泡里”是“被过度保护”的另一种说法，然后……

lines.en: : The joke really isn’t as funny when I have to explain it...
lines.zh: : 这笑话一解释就真的不好笑了……

lines.en: scene friendzonefight29
: Nonsense! I thought it was delightful. An excellent display of your sense of humor, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 胡说！我觉得妙极了。这充分展现了你的幽默感，Ayane。

lines.en: : I somehow feel even less funny after hearing that.
lines.zh: : 听完这话，我反倒觉得自己更不好笑了。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight30
: To answer your question...life like this has been rather difficult to adapt to.
lines.zh: : 回答你的问题……这种生活我适应起来相当吃力。

lines.en: : Though, I’m sure you know this given that you had to adapt to it yourself.
lines.zh: : 不过，你自己也得适应过，想必很清楚。

lines.en: : I know firsthand how hard that can be now, and I really respect you for being able to fit in so seamlessly at this point.
lines.zh: : 我现在切身体会到那有多难，也很佩服你能这么快就完全融入。

lines.en: : Actually, it’s the other way around for me.
lines.zh: : 其实我跟你是相反的。

lines.en: : My family was pretty poor for a long time before my dad’s invention took off.
lines.zh: : 在我爸的发明一炮而红之前，我们家穷了很长一段时间。

lines.en: : So if anything, I’d probably have a hard time getting used to that rich girl lifestyle you grew up with.
lines.zh: : 所以要是反过来，我大概很难习惯你从小过的那种大小姐生活。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight31
: Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是这样吗？

lines.en: : Yup! And, like I told you in class the other day, the whole rich person thing isn’t really my style.
lines.zh: : 没错！而且就像我前几天在课上跟你说的，有钱人那一套真不是我的风格。

lines.en: : I like it a lot living like this.
lines.zh: : 我很喜欢现在这样的生活。

lines.en: : I mean, I get to use my dad’s credit card to buy pretty much anything I want, so it’s not like I’m {i}not{/i} gonna take advantage of that-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我可以用我爸的信用卡买几乎所有我想要的东西，所以我{i}当然{/i}会好好利用这一点——

lines.en: : But still. I don’t think I’d {i}need{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 但话说回来。我觉得我并不{i}需要{/i}它。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that sooner or later, you won’t have to rely on wealth either.
lines.zh: : 而且我相信，迟早有一天你也不用再依赖财富了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Ayane. I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Ayane。我真的很感激。

lines.en: : Also, have you seen Yasu anywhere? She tends to wander off when I take my eyes off of her...
lines.zh: : 还有，你有在哪儿看到 Yasu 吗？我一不留神她就会走丢……

lines.en: scene black
scene friendzonefight16
: Welcome back. I’m still not interested.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来。我还是不感兴趣。

lines.en: : Not even a little?
lines.zh: : 一点都没有？

lines.en: : Can you score me front row seats to a Hikaru Utada concert?
lines.zh: : 你能给我弄到宇多田光演唱会的第一排座位吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even know who that is.
lines.zh: : 我连那是谁都不知道。

lines.en: : Then no. Not interested.
lines.zh: : 那就没戏。不感兴趣。

lines.en: : What if I told you that I’m not like everyone else who’s ever confessed to you?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你，我和那些向你表白过的人都不一样呢？

lines.en: : Well, yeah. I don’t normally hang out with old people.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。我平时可不跟老年人混在一起。

lines.en: : I meant that I’m actually interesting.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是我其实挺有趣的。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight32
: Pfft! Ahahahahaha! You! Interesting! Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 噗！啊哈哈哈哈哈！你！有趣！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : At least you’ve got a sense of humor!
lines.zh: : 至少你还有点幽默感！

lines.en: : Hahaha...hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈哈……哈……

lines.en: scene friendzonefight33
: You were being serious.
lines.zh: : 你是认真的。

lines.en: : I mean, I think I’m at least mildly interesting in the fact that I don’t really think the way anyone else does.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，至少我思考的方式和别人不太一样，这点应该还算有趣。

lines.en: : Neither does Nodoka and you don’t see me hooking up with her every night.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 想法也跟别人不一样，我也没见自己天天晚上跟她搞在一起啊。

lines.en: : You know where to find me~
lines.zh: : 你知道在哪儿能找到我~

lines.en: : See? I can completely resist her and she’s a lot cuter than you are.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？我完全能抵抗住她，而且她比你可爱好看多了。

lines.en: : Least when she’s not hopped up on caffeine.
lines.zh: : 至少在她没被咖啡因灌嗨的时候是这样。

lines.en: : Well then how the hell am I supposed to end this tournament thing?
lines.zh: : 那我到底要怎么结束这场锦标赛啊？

lines.en: : You’re completely uninterested and Rin apparently has a lawyer that is now going to prevent her from saying anything remotely incriminating.
lines.zh: : 你完全不感兴趣，而 Rin 显然有了个律师，现在会阻止她说出任何有那么一点自证其罪的话。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight34
: Oh. I didn’t realize Futaba and I were actually allowed to participate in that way.
lines.zh: : 哦。我没想到 Futaba 和我居然还能以这种方式参与。

lines.en: : I was planning on spending the morning basking in the glorious scent of coffee, but now that I know Futaba is {i}getting involved{/i}, allow me to do the same.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算整个上午都沐浴在咖啡的芬芳里，不过既然知道 Futaba 要{i}介入{/i}了，那我也一起吧。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I don’t really need help fending Sensei off.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我根本不需要帮忙对付 Sensei。

lines.en: : I know you don’t. But there’s an easy win condition for Sensei that could end this competition in the blink of an eye.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不需要。不过对 Sensei 来说，有个能眨眼间结束这场比赛的简易获胜条件。

lines.en: : He's likely just so smitten by all of us beautiful [young_girls] that he's yet to discern it.
lines.zh: : 他大概是太为我们这群漂亮的[young_girls]着迷了，所以还没发现。

lines.en: : It would also elicit quite the reaction if he were to employ it, so I’d be happy to see him try.
lines.zh: : 而且他要是真用上了，反应一定相当精彩，所以我很乐意看试试。

lines.en: : If you have some secret trick to picking up girls, please inform me. It would save me an extraordinary amount of time, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 如果你有什么泡妞的秘诀，请务必告诉我。综合来看，那能给我省下大把时间。

lines.en: : I can’t make anyone fall for you that won’t already fall for you of their own volition.
lines.zh: : 我没法让一个本来不会自愿喜欢上你的人喜欢上你。

lines.en: : But, and don’t let this shock you too much, I am extremely in tune with the heart of the bisexual [adolescent] girl.
lines.zh: : 不过，别太震惊，我对双性恋[adolescent]女孩的心思了如指掌。

lines.en: : If Rin doesn’t want {i}you{/i} which, to be fair, I think she may-
lines.zh: : 如果 Rin 不想要{i}你{/i}——说句公道话，我觉得她可能——

lines.en: : Promise her something she {i}does{/i} want.
lines.zh: : 那就许给她一个她{i}真{/i}正想要的东西。

lines.en: : But...what she wants is-
lines.zh: : 可是……她想要的是——

lines.en: scene friendzonefight35
: Oh, hell no! That’s playing dirty! I can win without that!
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对不行！这太脏了！不用这招我也能赢！

lines.en: : I can {i}guarantee{/i} you that simply offering up the chance to get naughty with both you {i}and{/i} Otoha is enough to end this contest right here and now. Scout’s honor.
lines.zh: : 我向你{i}保证{/i}，只要给出和你{i}还有{/i} Otoha 一起胡来的机会，就足以让这场比赛当场结束。童子军荣誉担保。

lines.en: : Absolutely not! We don’t-
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！我们不——

lines.en: : Say no more.
lines.zh: : 别说了。

lines.en: scene black
: Hey! Don’t make promises to her that you can’t keep!
lines.zh: : 喂！别对她许下你兑现不了的承诺！

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Been there, done that.
lines.zh: : 这种事我干过。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine this time being any more catastrophic than the last.
lines.zh: : 我想这次也不会比上次更灾难性。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?!
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？！

lines.en: else:
: Oh, I intend to keep this one. It just might take a long time to set into motion.
lines.zh: : 哦，这次我是打算兑现的。只不过可能要花很长时间才能启动。

lines.en: : Ew! No! Don't even joke about that!
lines.zh: : 恶心！不要！这种事别拿来开玩笑！

lines.en: scene friendzonefight36
: Well, Sensei...Rin and I talked it over and we’ll only be accepting certain conversation topics for the rest of the-
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei……我和 Rin 商量过了，接下来我们只接受某些特定的话题——

lines.en: : Rin, Otoha says she wants to have a threesome with you and me.
lines.zh: : Rin，Otoha 说她想和你还有我来个三人行。

lines.en: : Oh, come on...Like we would fall for-
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托……我们才不会上——

lines.en: scene friendzonefight37
: When and where?!
lines.zh: : 什么时候？在哪儿？！

lines.en: : Rin...he’s not being serious. If she really said something like that, it would mean they already-
lines.zh: : Rin……他不是认真的。如果她真说了那种话，那就意味着她们已经——

lines.en: : WHEN AND WHERE?!
lines.zh: : 什么时候？在哪儿？！

lines.en: : Uhh...the dorms, as soon as we’re done here.
lines.zh: : 呃……宿舍，等这儿一结束就去。

lines.en: : Okay!
: Okay?
: Okay! Yes! This is the best possible scenario for me!
lines.zh: : 好！当然！对我来说这是最理想的情况了！

lines.en: : Well, the {i}best{/i} possible scenario would be if we swapped you for Kaori.
lines.zh: : 好吧，{i}最最{/i}理想的情况是把你换成 Kaori。

lines.en: : But I’m definitely attracted to you and probably wouldn’t mind as long as-
lines.zh: : 不过我确实对你有感觉，而且大概也不会介意，只要——

lines.en: scene friendzonefight38
: Rin! Come on!
lines.zh: : Rin！拜托！

lines.en: : What? You can come too if you want. I'm sure Sensei can figure something out.
lines.zh: : 什么？你想来也可以啊。我相信 Sensei 总能想出办法的。

lines.en: : No! I mean you just lost us the game! You told Sensei he was attractive!
lines.zh: : 不是！我是说你刚刚让我们输掉了比赛！你告诉 Sensei 他很有吸引力！

lines.en: : Game? What are you-
lines.zh: : 比赛？你在说——

lines.en: scene friendzonefight39
: Ah!
: You tricked me!
lines.zh: : 你耍我！

lines.en: : My mind completely blanked the second I imagined Otoha naked!
lines.zh: : 我一想象 Otoha 裸体的样子，脑子就彻底空白了！

lines.en: : I can hear you...
lines.zh: : 我听得见……

lines.en: : Thank God she can’t hear me from all the way over here!
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，她从那么远的地方听不到我！

lines.en: : Ugh...this was Nodoka’s idea, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 呃……这是 Nodoka 的主意，对吧？

lines.en: : I should have seen this coming...
lines.zh: : 我早该料到的……

lines.en: : It’s probably a silly question, but...
lines.zh: : 这可能是个傻问题，不过……

lines.en: : The answer is no. It's not actually happening. And I’m just as upset as you are.
lines.zh: : 答案是不。不会真的发生的。我和你一样失望。

lines.en: scene friendzonefight40
: Ugh...
: Maybe someday...
lines.zh: : 也许有一天吧……

lines.en: : Maybe someday indeed...
lines.zh: : 是啊，也许有一天……

lines.en: scene black
I head over to Makoto to relay the results of the round to her, but she seems a bit distracted by some notebook in her hands.
lines.zh: 我走向 Makoto，想告诉她这一轮的结果，但她似乎被手里某个笔记本分了神。

lines.en: As I'm trying to make out what it is, Makoto informs me that she's just getting into the zone because her contest with Nodoka is coming up next.
lines.zh: 我正想看清那是什么，Makoto 告诉我她只是在进入状态，因为接下来就是她和 Nodoka 的比赛。

lines.en: Nodoka, on the other hand, doesn’t seem the slightest bit fazed.
lines.zh: 而 Nodoka 那边，看上去丝毫不为所动。

lines.en: So either she’s entirely too confident or...just doesn’t care at all.
lines.zh: 所以要么她自信过头，要么……根本就不在乎。

lines.en: Actually, knowing Nodoka, it’s probably both.
lines.zh: 说实话，以 Nodoka 的性子，大概两者都有。

lines.en: Regardless, the massive group reforms apart from a few stragglers as we all begin to make our way over to the[school] library...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，除了几个掉队的，这支浩浩荡荡的队伍重新集结，开始前往[school]图书馆……

lines.en: $ dorm2warpoints += 1
$ dormwar5 = True
Floor 1: [dorm1warpoints]\nFloor 2: [dorm2warpoints]
lines.zh:
一楼：[dorm1warpoints]
二楼：[dorm2warpoints]
